segments.sn3.19:1.2: Atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo divā divassa yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn3.19:1.3: “handa, kuto nu tvaṃ, mahārāja, āgacchasi divā divassā”ti?
segments.sn3.19:2.2: Tamahaṃ aputtakaṃ sāpateyyaṃ rājantepuraṃ atiharitvā āgacchāmi.
segments.sn3.19:2.3: Asīti, bhante, satasahassāni hiraññasseva, ko pana vādo rūpiyassa!
segments.sn3.19:2.4: Tassa kho pana, bhante, seṭṭhissa gahapatissa evarūpo bhattabhogo ahosi – kaṇājakaṃ bhuñjati bilaṅgadutiyaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:2.6: Evarūpo vatthabhogo ahosi – sāṇaṃ dhāreti tipakkhavasanaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:2.8: Evarūpo yānabhogo ahosi – jajjararathakena yāti paṇṇachattakena dhāriyamānenā”ti.
segments.sn3.19:3.2: Asappuriso kho, mahārāja, uḷāre bhoge labhitvā nevattānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti, na mātāpitaro sukheti pīṇeti, na puttadāraṃ sukheti pīṇeti, na dāsakammakaraporise sukheti pīṇeti, na mittāmacce sukheti pīṇeti, na samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:3.3: Tassa te bhoge evaṃ sammā aparibhuñjiyamāne [aparibhuñjamāno (sabbattha)] rājāno vā haranti corā vā haranti aggi vā ḍahati udakaṃ vā vahati appiyā vā dāyādā haranti.
segments.sn3.19:3.4: Evaṃsa te [evaṃ sante (sī. pī.)], mahārāja, bhogā sammā aparibhuñjiyamānā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, no paribhogaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:4.1: “Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, amanussaṭṭhāne pokkharaṇī acchodakā sītodakā sātodakā setodakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā.
segments.sn3.19:4.2: Taṃ jano neva hareyya na piveyya na nahāyeyya na yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya.
segments.sn3.19:4.3: Evañhi taṃ, mahārāja, udakaṃ sammā aparibhuñjiyamānaṃ [aparibhuñjamānaṃ (syā. kaṃ.)] parikkhayaṃ gaccheyya, no paribhogaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:4.4: Evameva kho, mahārāja, asappuriso uḷāre bhoge labhitvā nevattānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti, na mātāpitaro sukheti pīṇeti, na puttadāraṃ sukheti pīṇeti, na dāsakammakaraporise sukheti pīṇeti, na mittāmacce sukheti pīṇeti, na samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:4.5: Tassa te bhoge evaṃ sammā aparibhuñjiyamāne rājāno vā haranti corā vā haranti aggi vā ḍahati udakaṃ vā vahati appiyā vā dāyādā haranti.
segments.sn3.19:4.6: Evaṃsa te [evaṃ sante (sī. pī.)], mahārāja, bhogā sammā aparibhuñjiyamānā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, no paribhogaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:5.1: “Sappuriso ca kho, mahārāja, uḷāre bhoge labhitvā attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti, mātāpitaro sukheti pīṇeti, puttadāraṃ sukheti pīṇeti, dāsakammakaraporise sukheti pīṇeti, mittāmacce sukheti pīṇeti, samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:5.2: Tassa te bhoge evaṃ sammā paribhuñjiyamāne neva rājāno haranti, na corā haranti, na aggi ḍahati, na udakaṃ vahati, na appiyā dāyādā haranti.
segments.sn3.19:5.3: Evaṃsa te, mahārāja, bhogā sammā paribhuñjiyamānā paribhogaṃ gacchanti, no parikkhayaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:6.1: “Seyyathāpi, mahārāja, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre pokkharaṇī acchodakā sītodakā sātodakā setodakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā.
segments.sn3.19:6.2: Tañca udakaṃ jano hareyyapi piveyyapi nahāyeyyapi yathāpaccayampi kareyya.
segments.sn3.19:6.3: Evañhi taṃ, mahārāja, udakaṃ sammā paribhuñjiyamānaṃ paribhogaṃ gaccheyya, no parikkhayaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:6.4: Evameva kho, mahārāja, sappuriso uḷāre bhoge labhitvā attānaṃ sukheti pīṇeti, mātāpitaro sukheti pīṇeti, puttadāraṃ sukheti pīṇeti, dāsakammakaraporise sukheti pīṇeti, mittāmacce sukheti pīṇeti, samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddhaggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpeti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.
segments.sn3.19:6.5: Tassa te bhoge evaṃ sammā paribhuñjiyamāne neva rājāno haranti, na corā haranti, na aggi ḍahati, na udakaṃ vahati, na appiyā dāyādā haranti.
segments.sn3.19:6.6: Evaṃsa te, mahārāja, bhogā sammā paribhuñjiyamānā paribhogaṃ gacchanti, no parikkhayan”ti.

lines: Navame divā divassāti divasassa divā, majjhanhikasamayeti attho.
Ko pana vādo rūpiyassāti suvaṇṇarajatatambalohakāḷalohaphālakacchapakādibhedassa ghanakatassa ceva paribhogabhājanādibhedassa ca rūpiyabhaṇḍassa pana ko vādo?
Tipakkhavasananti tīṇi khaṇḍāni dvīsu ṭhānesu sibbitvā katanivāsanaṃ.
Taṃ janoti yena udakena sātodakā, taṃ udakaṃ jano bhājanāni pūretvā neva hareyya.
Na yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyyāti, yaṃ yaṃ udakena udakakiccaṃ kātabbaṃ, taṃ taṃ na kareyya.
Kiccakaro ca hotīti attanā kattabbakiccakaro ceva kusalakiccakaro ca, bhuñjati ca, kammante ca payojeti, dānañca detīti attho.
Diva-saddo divā-saddo viya divasapariyāyo, tasmā visesanabhāvena vuccamāno divasaddo atthavisesaṃ dīpetīti āha “divasassa divā”tiādi.
Saṃ vuccati dhanaṃ, tassa patīti sampati, dhanasāmiko, tassa hitāvahattā sāpateyyanti āha “sāpateyyanti dhanan”ti.
Tassa gehe katākatabhaṇḍassa atibahubhāvato vimhayappatto rājā “ko pana vādo”ti āha.
Bilaṅgaṃ vuccati dhaññabilaṅgaṃ, āranālantipi vuccati, taṃ dutiyaṃ assāti bilaṅgadutiyaṃ.
Kammassa nibbattabhāvena otaraṇatāya phalaṃ aggaṃ nāma, uparibhūmigatattā uddhaṃ aggaṃ assāti uddhaggikaṃ.
Saggo nāma kāmabhavūpapattibhavo, tassa nibbattanato “saggassa hitā”ti vuttaṃ.
So yena bhāvena yattha pākaṭataro hutvā dissati, taṃ dassetuṃ “vīcīnaṃ bhinnaṭṭhāne”ti āha.
Attanā kattabbakiccakaroti attanā kātabbakammasaṅkhātakiccakaro, paribhogavasena ceva saṅgahetabbasaṅgaṇhanavasena ca niyojakoti attho.
